notes: windmill_04 banner is a gold sun on a gold field (emblem on its own colour, a rule breach), and at hero size its dark-edged ring half-reads as a crescent; windmill_02 has a hay-thatch cap with no emerald roof, so green rests on two sails. The sun style (bronze-outlined gold disc) does not match the castle kit ivory starburst, and on windmill_01 the ladder hides the crown banner.
